tags.name: arcgis-plane-navigation
tags.description: Fly an aircraft in a caller-owned ArcGIS 3D scene. Set the scene with `reference-element` in HTML; assign `view`, `referenceElement`, or `config` as JavaScript properties. See the API reference for methods and events.

attributes.name: reference-element
attributes.description: Type: string. ID of a caller-owned `<arcgis-scene>` in the same document. A directly assigned `view` or `referenceElement` property takes precedence.

attributes.name: start-longitude
attributes.description: Type: number. Starting longitude in degrees. Supply together with `start-latitude`.

attributes.name: start-latitude
attributes.description: Type: number. Starting latitude in degrees, from -90 to 90. Supply together with `start-longitude`.

attributes.name: start-altitude-m
attributes.description: Type: number. Starting absolute altitude in metres. Omit to start above sampled terrain.

attributes.name: start-heading-deg
attributes.description: Type: number. Starting heading in degrees clockwise from north.

attributes.name: start-speed-mps
attributes.description: Type: number. Initial forward speed. Uses metres per second in local scenes and projected scene units per second in global Web Mercator scenes.

attributes.name: camera-mode
attributes.description: Type: "chase" | "cockpit". Initial camera view. Changes to this attribute update the active flight without restarting it.

attributes.name: power-mode
attributes.description: Type: "slow" | "normal" | "turbo". Initial flight power mode: brake toward slow speed, cruise normally, or use turbo boost.

attributes.name: sensitivity
attributes.description: Type: number. Keyboard, gamepad, and touch control sensitivity, clamped to 0.5 through 2.

attributes.name: fov-deg
attributes.description: Type: number. Base camera field of view in degrees, clamped to 58 through 76.

attributes.name: invert-pitch-disabled
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence disables the default inverted pitch control. Remove the attribute to restore the default; `="false"` still counts as present.

attributes.name: camera-roll-disabled
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence disables banked viewport roll during turns.

attributes.name: keyboard-disabled
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence disables keyboard flight input.

attributes.name: gamepad-disabled
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence disables gamepad flight input.

attributes.name: capture-scene-navigation-disabled
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence leaves ArcGIS scene navigation gestures under the host's control.

attributes.name: auto-start-disabled
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence initializes flight in the ready state; call `start()` to begin flying.

attributes.name: show-controls
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence shows the built-in flight toolbar.

attributes.name: joystick
attributes.description: Type: "auto" | "always" | "never". Touch joystick visibility. `auto` shows it on coarse-pointer devices, independently of the toolbar.

attributes.name: joystick-position
attributes.description: Type: "top-left" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-right" | "top-start" | "top-end" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-end". ArcGIS scene slot for the touch joystick; defaults to `bottom-left`.

attributes.name: ui-position
attributes.description: Type: "top-left" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-right" | "top-start" | "top-end" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-end". ArcGIS scene slot for the built-in toolbar; defaults to `bottom-end`.

attributes.name: ui-controls
attributes.description: Type: string. Unique toolbar controls separated by spaces or commas: `power`, `pause`, `camera`, `recover`.

attributes.name: show-speed
attributes.description: Type: boolean (presence). Presence shows the speed readout in the built-in toolbar.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Type: "auto" | "en" | "de" | "fr" | "it" | "es". Language for built-in controls. `auto` follows ArcGIS, document, then browser language.
